topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture scope and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how somatic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages during cancer progression.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stem cell properties, differentiation hierarchies, and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependence in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how inflammatory microenvironments and supportive stromal cells act as essential promoters of tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for investigating tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the sequencing, spatial profiling, and computational technologies used to analyse tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides a comprehensive framework integrating genetic, epigenetic, cellular, and microenvironmental factors to explain tumor development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
